svg.text: CHAT - ONE_TO_ONE / GROUP conversations, one receipt per recipient, blocks, edits, scheduled messages, seeded masters
AUTH & PLATFORM - tables the existing login / session / otp / audit / upload code reads

Every table: is_active TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP. Ids BIGINT UNSIGNED. InnoDB, utf8mb4.
